title: Strategy and research
outcomes: a strategy-to-execution review naming conflicts, unlinked work, infeasible commitments, capacity ranges, and recommended decisions
a research finding with sources classed and assumptions stated
inputs: the strategy documents declared as sources
work-tracking, roadmap, and people or capacity sources, each with its declared authority
